data.summary: The codex epoch ep-9e40a91d49dc dispatched and the binary ran, but every request returned 401 Unauthorized. Measured cause: this host has no stored codex credential -- ~/.codex/auth.json and ~/.hermes/auth.json do not exist, and orca/codex-runtime-home/system-default-auth.json holds authJson: null beside a runtime-logout marker. The host application brokers auth per session, so an unattended process cannot authenticate. External condition, Owner-resolvable: `codex login`.
